question: Which state government approved the "Mukhyamantri Ekal Mahila Swarozgar Yojana" to empower single women?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Uttarakhand.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Uttarakhand approves "Mukhyamantri Ekal Mahila Swarozgar Yojana" to empower single women.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The scheme aims to empower unmarried, divorced, abandoned, destitute, and differently-abled single women.**
 
• Financial assistance of up to 2 lakh rupees will be provided, with 75% as a grant and the remaining 25% to be contributed by the beneficiaries.
 
• In the first phase, at least 2,000 women will benefit from the scheme, with plans to increase the number of beneficiaries based on its progress.
 
• Minister Rekha Arya described it as an early Women's Day gift, designed to promote financial independence and self-reliance among women.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Women Empowerment__

 __
 
• Programs like these are aimed at making women financially independent and self-reliant.
 
 
 
• Financial Assistance Schemes__
 
 
• Such schemes are important in providing financial support to marginalized sections of society.
